name: Himuka
source:
A boy known as the Undertaker.
He has an extremely strong power of Batsu and silently transforms the souls of the people of Yomi into Shou every day.
As he never talks about himself, few people know anything about him.

[spoiler]His true identity is Hiruko.

[spoiler]In "Catharsis" he is happy that the amount of funeral work has decreased, and has also started selling bread. Through his business dealings, he deepens his relationships with the people and decides to find a way to contribute to the island.
